name: Studio-be
reason: One-teacher studio (all classes taught by founder Valerie Speidel) in Kitsilano, Vancouver, 3361 W 3rd Ave. Offers only one weekly-class session programme (Fall 2026 already running, $420 per 14 weeks); the classes page says workshops, drop-ins and private classes are not offered this session. Fewer than about 3 items. Email yoga@studio-be.ca and a contact form exist, so it could be revisited if workshops return.
